test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: To gain 25% after announcing a discount of 10%, the shopkeeper must mark the price of the article with cost price Rs. 360 as:
solution:
**Given:**

Gain = 25%

Discount = 10%

CP = Rs. 360

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price be x

According to the question

x – [x ×(10/100)] – [(25 × 360)/100] = 360

⇒ x – x/10 – 90 = 360 

⇒ 9x/10 = 360 + 90

⇒ 9x/10 = 450

⇒ 9x = 4500

⇒ x = 500

**∴ The marked price is Rs. 500**
